l-e-e4-b03-12.material: Filimku waa from 1 to 3 (2 saacadood). Fasalku waa from 2 to 5 (3 saacadood). Ciyaartu waa from 4 to 5 (1 saacad). Isticmaal xeerka si aad u hesho imisa saacadood ayaa ah from 6 to 9.
l-e-e4-b03-12.s.s1.prompt: Imisa saacadood ayaa ah from 6 to 9?
l-e-e4-b03-12.s.s1.r.a: 6 waa waqtiga bilowga oo keliya. Waa inaad ka jartaa bilowga dhammaadka.
l-e-e4-b03-12.s.s1.r.c: Waa qiimaha 6 iyo 9 la isku daray. Tusaalayaasha, qiimayaasha waa la jaray.
l-e-e4-b03-12.s.s1.explain: Ka jar waqtiga bilowga waqtiga dhammaadka. 9 − 6 = 3, sidaa darteed waa 3 saacadood.
l-e-e4-b03-12.s.s2.model.0: Tusaalayaasha, bilowga waa laga jaray dhammaadka, sida 3 − 1 = 2 iyo 5 − 2 = 3, sidaa darteed 9 − 6 = 3 saacadood.
l-e-e4-b03-12.s.s2.model.1: Waqtiga dhammaadka − waqtiga bilowga waa waqtiga la qaatay, sidaa darteed from 6 to 9 waa 3 saacadood.
